ecrans.titre: Open a tab from the sidebar
ecrans.texte: The + of Browsers asks for an address and adds the tab with its row. It opens full screen, or beside the agent with Open beside.

ecrans.titre: Let the agent show you what it sees
ecrans.texte: In the tab it opens for you, the agent scrolls, circles an element or switches to mobile width. Your first gesture in the page gives you the hand back.

ecrans.titre: Choose in the page the agent shows you
ecrans.texte: An agent opens a review, a diagram or a comparison beside its conversation, with its row under Browsers. Pick an option in the page: Send passes your answer on.

ecrans.titre: Give your agents a page of your own
ecrans.texte: In Settings › Projects › Launch, Page of your own names an .html document of your project. Your agents fill it and show it to you like their pages.

ecrans.titre: Follow your agents on the Workspace canvas
ecrans.texte: Open it from Editor or the Overview: each agent shows its workflow step there. Workflows lists the project’s workflows and the agents that follow them.
